column1: # Partition table for the receiver — a custom ESP-IDF table (selected via
# CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_CUSTOM in sdkconfig.defaults). A custom table is
# required because no built-in preset carves out a filesystem partition
# firmware stores its power-on/shutdown recordings on LittleFS (mounted on the
# "storage" partition below — see main.cpp
# matches the partition by label
# Minimal 4 MB layout: a single factory app (no OTA — we always flash over
# USB/serial) and a 2 MB storage partition. nvs holds the receiver's saved baud
# and strip geometry. pwrcfg is a 4 KB sector holding the power-switch wiring
# (see power_switch.cpp)
column2: written at flash time by `make flash PWR=on` /

column1: # `make flash-pwr` — its own partition so it survives app reflashes and needs
# no toolchain to write. fancfg is the same idea for the PWM fan controller
# (see fan.cpp; `make flash FAN=on` / `make flash-fan`) — carved out of the
# factory tail so pwrcfg and storage keep their offsets and deployed configs
# survive this table change. blecfg (the BLE power remote
# `make flash BLE=on` / `make flash-ble`) is the next 4 KB bite of the same
# tail
column2: again leaving every existing offset alone.
